messages:
anya: Quick async standup — routing v2 launch next Tue. Need: final spec signoff, QA checklist, canary window, and PR review bandwidth. Who's where? :eyes:
mike: Finished the rollout spec draft. Uploaded to the doc: https://redwood.internal/specs/routing-v2 — ping @sam @lee for perf/edge cases. I have one open PR for the rate limiter change, needs review.
sam: Looking now. Main blocker is the cache key change — impacts embeddings TTL. Will post comments by EOD.
lee: Ran integration tests this morning; found a flake in kv-cache invalidation when sequence length > 4096. Repro steps in the thread below.
lee: Repro (short):
```
# run repro harness
python tests/repro_kv_cache.py --seq 5000 --seed 42
# observe stale kv entries after chunked attention path triggers
```
lee: Filing a small fix, but it may require a model-variant config toggle. If we ship without the toggle, some long-context workloads could see correctness regressions.
eva: For QA, I can run the canary in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Prefer 2-hour windows during low traffic (03:00-05:00 UTC). Are those okay? :satellite:
mike: 03:00-05:00 UTC SGTM. @ci-bot can we schedule a canary job?
ci-bot: CI: Canary pipeline created: pipeline/routing-v2-canary. Triggers: manual, cron @ 02:50 UTC. Logs will stream to https://ci.redwood/pipelines/routing-v2-canary. :gear:
anya: Good — make sure the canary includes the new config toggle so we can flip if the kv-fix regresses. Also need product signoff on UX handling for degraded latencies (timeout fallback copy).
sam: UX text approved in the doc (line 124). For fallback we show: "Experiencing high latency, results may be delayed" and fallback to smaller model after 3s.
mike: I'll add the feature flag and a quick e2e smoke test. Adding a smoke curl for reviewers:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"input":"short test", "timeout_ms":3000}'
```
mike: If response status == 200 and body contains "result" then smoke passes.
lee: I'll hold the PR review until the kv-fix is in. ETA for kv-fix PR: tomorrow morning.
eva: QA schedule: smoke + perf run in canary window, then 1-hour soak. If green, we promote to canary-2 (larger %). I will post results in this thread.
anya: Thanks. Final checklist before signoff: spec doc updated, kv-fix merged or feature-flagged, smoke test added to CI, canary scheduled, UX fallback text in place, and at least 1 cross-team reviewer signed. Who can be the cross-team reviewer? @lee?
lee: I can be cross-team reviewer for infra/perf.
mike: @anya I still need a second reviewer for API surface (maybe @sam?).
sam: I can do API review after I finish the cache comments — likely by tonight.
anya: Perfect. If all that lands, we target canary kickoff Tue 02:50 UTC and alert page on-call 10m prior. I'll update the launch slack and product checklist. :rocket: 
ci-bot: Reminder: create postmortem template if any canary failures observed.
mike: One more quick ask — any changes to client SDKs that need a minor version bump? I added a note in the spec but no code yet.
sam: SDK change: add optional param `fallback_model` to `route()` call. Minor bump yes. I'll queue it after API review.
anya: Great. Blockers summary: kv-cache flake (lee working), PR review bandwidth (sam + lee), SDK minor bump after API signoff, QA canary windows confirmed. If nothing else, we'll reconvene here tomorrow with status.
lee: Will post kv-fix PR link when ready.
eva: I'll queue the canary run and add the soak dashboard.
mike: thx all.
anya: :thumbsup:
